stories.headline: ASEAN Film Festival promotes cinematic diversity and fosters cultural exchange

opening: [The content of this article has been produced by our advertising partner.] The ASEAN Film Festival (AFF) officially opened on August 20 at an event attended by government officials, Consuls-General, cultural partners, and filmmakers from across the region.

Running until September 27, this year’s festival serves as a vibrant crossroads where stories from Southeast Asia and beyond converge to bridge cultures, spark conversation, and deepen mutual understanding.
